headline: Sensex and Nifty crash over 1,200 points amid global selloff; NSE shares surge on debut day

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices surged above $100 per barrel
Rising US Treasury yields and a selloff in US markets
Weakness in the Indian rupee against the US dollar
Negative global cues from GIFT Nifty and Asian markets
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty hit three-month lows during a sharp intraday crash
NSE shares debuted and jumped over 5%, entering the top 10 most valued firms club
Info Edge shares plunged 7% following a sharp decline in PB Fintech's valuation
Reliance Industries is looking to raise Rs 10,000 crore through a debt fundraise
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a massive crash with the Sensex falling 1,200 points due to surging crude oil prices and rising US yields. In contrast, the NSE made a strong market debut, rising over 5% to join the top 10 most valued Indian companies. Meanwhile, Info Edge and PB Fintech faced significant selling pressure, contributing to the overall bearish sentiment.
